title: Certificate trunk never registers
brief: A new local gateway points at the registration port. The trunk type in Control Hub is certificate-based.
log:
SYNTHETIC
CUBE# show sip-ua register status
Line not registered
Outbound TLS destination port 8934
Control Hub trunk: certificate-based
Firewall log: SYN to 8934 allowed, no session to 5062

checks.q: Which destination port does the port reference require for a certificate-based trunk?

fix: Point the certificate-based trunk at TCP 5062. Keep 8934 for registration-based trunks. Confirm SIP ALG is off.

title: 911 follows the PSTN because the location is not enabled
brief: Users dial 911 and the carrier gets a call with no dispatchable location. The RedSky toggle for the location is off.
log:
SYNTHETIC
Location Richmond emergency calling: disabled
HELD company ID: empty
933 result: not placed
PSTN CDR: 911 sent on the local gateway

checks.q: If enhanced emergency calling is not enabled, where does the lab send 911?
What should be tested after the location is enabled and phones resync?

fix: Enter the HELD company ID and secret, enable the location, resync MPP phones, and place a 933 test. International locations still use PSTN for emergency calling.

title: A pattern that almost matches
brief: 918045551234 should use the Richmond trunk. The dial plan pattern is one digit short.
log:
SYNTHETIC
Dialed 918045551234
Location external digit 9
Pattern on the plan: +18045551XXX
Result: unmatched, sent to the location local gateway as a default
Expected pattern shape: +1804555XXXX

checks.q: After the external digit is stripped, the US teaching normalization of 18045551234 is
A dial plan's routing choice is
choices: A trunk or a route group

fix: Fix the pattern length so +18045551234 matches, and confirm the route is the intended trunk or route group. The lab simulator is not Control Hub.

title: A premises user tries the cloud PSTN
brief: A PBX behind the local gateway sends a call that the design hoped Cloud Connected PSTN would complete.
log:
SYNTHETIC
Origin: premises PBX user
Location PSTN: Cloud Connected PSTN
Dialed +18045551234
Result: blocked
Note: cloud PSTN is for Webex Calling users

choices: Only Dedicated Instance phones, with no trunk

checks.q: How many trunks can a premises-PSTN location select?

fix: Keep premises-origin calls on the local gateway. Use cloud PSTN for Webex Calling users. Do not assign two trunks to one premises location.

title: The wrong queue's agent cap
brief: A contact center design was limited to 50 agents because someone read the Calling Simultaneous cap.
log:
SYNTHETIC design note
Product: Webex Contact Center queue
Cap applied: 50 (Simultaneous)
Source pasted: Webex Calling call queue article
Strategy wanted: LAA

checks.q: Circular, Top Down, Longest Idle, Weighted, and Simultaneous belong to
Contact center routing strategies named in this lab are

fix: Remove the Calling cap from the contact center queue. Cite the routing article for LAA or BAA. Do not invent a RONA timer.

title: The bot webhook disabled itself
brief: A listener crashed and returned errors. Messaging stopped calling it.
log:
SYNTHETIC
Webhook messages created 09:00
HTTP 500 x 100 between 09:01 and 09:04
Status: disabled
Signature code: HMAC after JSON.parse and stringify
Header read: X-Spark-Signature case-sensitive, missed lowercase
fix: Hash the raw bytes, compare in constant time, return 2xx only when the event is stored, and recreate the webhook if it is disabled. Use X-WebexCC-Signature for contact center, not this header.

title: Dedicated Instance cannot call multi-tenant users
brief: Activation finished. The interop SIP trunk was never activated. DNS for the phones is a separate fault, and this one is the trunk.
log:
SYNTHETIC
Calling > Dedicated Instance > Manage: UC apps present
Interop SIP trunk: not activated
DI user 2100 calls multi-tenant 2200: fail
933 on a multi-tenant phone: ok

checks.q: The activation article says you must
choices: Activate the interop SIP trunk to multi-tenant

checks.q: Cross-launch of the UC apps is under

fix: Activate the interop SIP trunk using Cisco's interop article. Do not confuse it with the Meetings SIP trunk described on the deployment-models page.

title: CallQueueBulk.csv still has an Errors column
brief: The hunt-to-queue export was uploaded without reading the notes. Control Hub rejected it.
log:
SYNTHETIC bulk result
File: CallQueueBulk.csv
Header tail: Errors,Notes
Row 4: Location can't be derived based on the Call Queue number from UCM
Row 5: number assigned to another user
Upload: rejected

choices: Fix the errors and remove the Errors and Notes columns
Leave the columns so Control Hub can read them
Rename the file to a flow

fix: Fill location, language, and time zone where they were not derived, resolve number collisions, delete the Errors and Notes columns, and upload with the call queue bulk tool.
